fields.description: Read mode: one row per sheet row, keyed by the header row (column names vary by sheet). A run that reads 0 rows adds one free row with status "no_results" and reason. Write mode leaves the dataset empty; see OUTPUT.

status.title: Status
status.description: Only on the free status row: "no_results".

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Only on the free status row: why nothing was read.

overview.title: Rows
overview.description: Rows imported from the sheet (read). Columns match your sheet header.
